# Open hallway: `hallway-open` 0.1.0

Straight hallway with a floor and two side walls, open at both ends. No doors, rooms, end walls, or ceiling.

## Purpose

The first shared world for the MuJoCo and Gazebo simulators: one straight
hallway, open at both ends, with no doors. It lets a verifier show that both
engines loaded the same dimensions, places and collision boundaries using a
plain sphere probe. No robot or controller is involved; "G1 walks from the
entrance to the exit" is a later story.

Stories that use it (robot-capability-specs v1.3.0):

1. An integrator selects the open hallway by name and version.
2. A scenario author uses the declared hallway places.
3. A verifier compares MuJoCo and Gazebo hallway evidence.
4. A reviewer inspects retained hallway results from both engines.
5. A consumer meets an unsupported hallway feature.

Specification: [Living-Proof-Labs/robot-capability-specs v1.3.0](https://github.com/Living-Proof-Labs/robot-capability-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/worlds/hallways.md) (document revision
0.2.0, world contract revision 0.2.0, commit `ad53368c11b322b787f6b71023bbe87dec839c0b`).

## Named places

All coordinates are metres in the world frame.

| Name | Type | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entrance` | segment | (-3.00, -0.75, 0.00) to (-3.00, 0.75, 0.00); reference (-3.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `exit` | segment | (3.00, -0.75, 0.00) to (3.00, 0.75, 0.00); reference (3.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `passage` | region | x = [-3.00, 3.00], y = [-0.50, 0.50] |
| `passage-centreline` | polyline | (-3.00, 0.00, 0.00) → (3.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `spawn-entrance` | pose | (-2.50, 0.00, 0.00), yaw 0.0° |
| `spawn-centre` | pose | (0.00, 0.00, 0.00), yaw 0.0° |
| `spawn-exit` | pose | (2.50, 0.00, 0.00), yaw 180.0° |

## Frame and tolerances

- Right-handed, metres. Origin: centre of the floor top surface.
- `+x`: along the hallway from entrance to exit; `+y`: across the hallway; `+z`: up.
- Pose: position (x, y, z) plus yaw in degrees, positive about +z.
- Tolerances: 0.01 m for distances and places, 0.5° for axes and yaw.

## Simulator support

| Simulator | Status | Known differences |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MuJoCo | Not yet loaded; adapter pending in livingproof-sim-mujoco | None recorded |
| Gazebo | Not yet loaded; adapter pending in livingproof-sim-gazebo | None recorded |

All geometry is boxes, which both engines support, so no feature is expected to
be `UNSUPPORTED`. An adapter that cannot load a declared feature must fail with
`UNSUPPORTED` naming it. Equivalent geometry does not imply identical physics.
